target: xVulnv2 (The Local Plate) Restaurant Web App

entry_points: main.go (HTTP backend on :4443, HTTP frontend on :4444)

runtime_dependencies.name: github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go
runtime_dependencies.notes: Archived upstream (replaced by github.com/golang-jwt/jwt). Repo intentionally retains this for dependency-scanner visibility.

runtime_dependencies.name: github.com/gorilla/mux
runtime_dependencies.notes: Maintenance mode. Adequate for short-lived lab apps.

runtime_dependencies.name: github.com/gorilla/sessions
runtime_dependencies.notes: Used as backend for middleware/session.go (cookie store).

runtime_dependencies.name: github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3
runtime_dependencies.notes: CGO binding to SQLite. Required for restaurant.db.

datastores.name: SQLite (restaurant.db)
datastores.notes: Plaintext password storage. WAL mode enabled.

external_services.name: User-supplied URLs via /api/kitchen/recipes/view?source= (RFI target)
external_services.notes: Server-side http.Get on attacker-controlled URL when source starts with http(s)://.

build_and_tooling.name: Makefile (xVulnv2 build orchestration)
build_and_tooling.notes: Builds xvulnv2 binary and xvulnctl CLI. Manages reset/scan/report workflows.

build_and_tooling.name: Embedded report template (cmd/xvulnctl/report_template.html)
build_and_tooling.notes: go:embed HTML template for benchmark reports.

vendored_or_artifacts.name: xvulnctl
vendored_or_artifacts.notes: Pre-built CLI binary present at repo root (supply-chain concern: should not be in source).

vendored_or_artifacts.name: xvulnv2
vendored_or_artifacts.notes: Pre-built server binary present at repo root.

security_relevant_dependencies.name: github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go
security_relevant_dependencies.rationale: Archived upstream. Has multiple historical CVEs. However, the lab does NOT use this library — it ships a custom HMAC-SHA256 + base64url JWT implementation in handlers/advanced_lab.go (issueLabJWT/parseLabJWT). The dependency is present in go.mod only to be flagged by SCA scanners.
security_relevant_dependencies.audit_verdict: Kept in go.mod for benchmark SCA, but not used in code paths. Vulnerabilities would not be reachable.

security_relevant_dependencies.name: github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3
security_relevant_dependencies.rationale: CGO SQLite driver. No known critical CVEs at version; standard upstream quality.

security_relevant_dependencies.name: github.com/gorilla/sessions
security_relevant_dependencies.rationale: Maintenance-mode library. Lab uses it for cookie-backed sessions with hardcoded default secret. The library itself is sound; the misuse is in the application config (see finding F-A5).

static_assets.notes: SPA served on :4444. Single-file frontend containing all page templates and API call logic.
Publicly served via /static/uploads/menus/. Any authenticated user can upload arbitrary content (V15).
Publicly served invoice exports with predictable names (V19).

trust_boundaries.name: Public Internet → Backend (:4443)
trust_boundaries.controls: CORS (echo origin + credentials), Logger middleware, LocalhostOnly on /api/reset (default)
trust_boundaries.weakness: CORS allows credentials with any origin. No rate limiting. No auth on most read endpoints.

trust_boundaries.name: Public Internet → Frontend (:4444)
trust_boundaries.weakness: No CSP, X-Frame-Options, or other security headers. SPA content is not locked down.

trust_boundaries.name: Browser Session → Authenticated API
trust_boundaries.weakness: SameSite=None is needed for cross-port SPA but combined with credentialed CORS echo enables cross-origin session abuse (V12 + CORS).

trust_boundaries.name: User → Admin Routes
trust_boundaries.controls: X-Admin-Token header check OR session presence (no role verification)
trust_boundaries.weakness: Hardcoded bypass token. Session fallback doesn't check role==admin (V07).

trust_boundaries.name: Process → Filesystem
trust_boundaries.controls: filepath.Join in some places, no auth on /api/files
trust_boundaries.weakness: Path traversal on /api/files (V13). LFI on /api/kitchen/recipes/view (V17). Predictable filenames in /static/exports/tmp (V19).

trust_boundaries.name: Process → External Network
trust_boundaries.weakness: SSRF on /api/import-menu (V04). RFI on /api/kitchen/recipes/view when source starts with http(s):// (V17).

trust_boundaries.name: Process → SQLite DB
trust_boundaries.controls: Parameterized queries in most places; raw concatenation in V01/V02/various
trust_boundaries.weakness: SQL injection in /api/menu/{id}, /api/menu?category=, /api/search?q= (V01, V02). Also in /api/admin/menu/upload-image filename (not exploitable but sloppy).

trust_boundaries.name: Process → JWT validation
trust_boundaries.weakness: alg=none accepted, no exp/iss/aud checks, hardcoded weak secret, signature check bypass when len(parts)==2 (V20).

trust_boundary_crossings: Untrusted JSON body → DB write (no schema validation in several handlers)
Untrusted multipart filename → public file system (V15)
